mapper.sql: select id, username, avatar_url, enabled, status, locked, user_expire_time, credential_expire_time, login_times, last_login_time, last_login_ip, op_mode, description, created_time, created_by, updated_time, updated_by from `user`
mapper.insert: insert into `user` (username, password, avatar_url, enabled, status, locked, user_expire_time, credential_expire_time, login_times, last_login_time, last_login_ip, op_mode, description, created_time, updated_time, created_by, updated_by) values (#{username}, #{password}, #{avatarUrl}, #{enabled}, #{status}, #{locked}, #{userExpireTime}, #{credentialExpireTime}, #{loginTimes}, #{lastLoginTime}, #{lastLoginIp}, #{opMode}, #{description}, #{createdTime}, #{updatedTime}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.update: update `user` set login_times = login_times + 1, last_login_time = COALESCE(#{lastLoginTime}, last_login_time), last_login_ip = COALESCE(#{lastLoginIp}, last_login_ip) where id = #{id}
